interpretation: Round0 has one primer per cell and q4pair then q8. Round1 restarts each block process, has no further primer and runs q8 first. Startup/use state and request order are aliased; the sign reverses. Neither round splitting nor pooled totals identify steady-state physical-width efficiency or a live-service effect.

stop_decision.reason: No cleanly attributed removable hotspot is established by these diagnostics. Preserve the limited old k3 recommendation; no claim that q8 inherently loses or wins. A future matched-warmth/persistent-process diagnostic needs separate registration, not selective repetition here.

sampled_memory.scope: Selected-device total-minus-free; sampled lower bound, not exact per-process peak

resource_observer.scope: No proof against all short events, existing-service requests, shared interconnect traffic or unobserved interference. GPU host guards separately sample every2s.

qualification_scope: All8 vectors and initial/final active KV/frontier for32 equal-work cells. Clean timing checks all8 output hashes and bounds, without online KV export. This is not new live EOG/cap/rollback qualification.
